subject: Pen test remediation verification & SIG evidence follow-up
messages:
From: Claire Jacobs <security@brighthealth.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Brian Miller <brian.miller@brighthealth.io>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: confirmation of remediation and next steps for pen test

Ethan —

Thanks again for coordinating on the September penetration test. We received Redwood's remediation plan and the initial artifacts, but before we close our SIG/Security review we need two things: a short verification letter confirming the fixes were applied, and the redacted PT report (or confirmation that RapidSec will re-run validation and provide a delta). For clarity, our procurement and InfoSec teams will accept either: (A) a vendor-signed retest/delta report, or (B) a Redwood-signed verification letter + evidence bundle if the retest is out of scope.

Can you confirm which path you prefer and share a proposed retest window (ideally within the next two weeks)? Also attach any evidence you already have (e.g., patch IDs, remediation tickets, screenshots).

Attachments: Bright_Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx (we shared previously)

Best,
Claire
Claire Jacobs
Information Security Manager, BrightHealth

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jacobs <security@brighthealth.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of remediation and next steps for pen test

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: we can support option (A) or (B), but for BrightHealth's timeline we recommend scheduling a short targeted retest with RapidSec so you get an independent delta — that keeps your audit trail tight. If you prefer Redwood attestation instead, we can provide a signed verification letter and a redacted evidence bundle.

What we can provide immediately:
- A redacted copy of the original pen test report (RI-PT-2026-09-report-redacted.pdf)
- A remediation evidence bundle (remediation-evidence-binder.zip) containing patch IDs, remediation Jira links, screenshots of configuration changes, and CVE mitigation notes

Proposed retest window: Jan 18–20 (we can lock a two-hour validation window per agreed scope). If that works, I'll loop RapidSec and Vivek (ops lead) to confirm scope and access. If you prefer Redwood's verification letter first, say the word and I'll attach a signed letter by end of week.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm preferred path (retest vs. Redwood letter)
2) If retest: confirm windows and a short scope matrix (we'll limit to the remediated endpoints)
3) If letter: confirm BrightHealth recipient(s) and any phrasing requirements

I've attached the evidence bundle in this thread for your review.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: remediation-evidence-binder.zip

From: RapidSec Ops <ops@rapidsec.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Claire Jacobs <security@brighthealth.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of remediation and next steps for pen test

Ethan / Claire —

RapidSec can run a focused delta assessment on Jan 18 between 09:00–12:00 PST. To scope the work we need:
- Confirmation of exactly which endpoints/IPs/services were remediated (list or CIDR)
- A brief list of remediation tickets or PRs (Jira links are fine)
- Temporary test creds or a read-only test account and an owner to accept scanning (we can use a verification webhook to confirm access)

If those items are provided by Jan 13 EOD we can commit to publishing a short delta report within 3 business days of the test (includes findings, reproduction steps, and whether the original findings persist). If BrightHealth prefers Redwood's verification letter in lieu of a retest, we can still provide the delta later on request.

Thanks,
RapidSec Ops

On Thu, Jan 7, 2027 at 14:22 Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — looping Vivek to provision test accounts and finalize scope.
>
> -E

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jacobs <security@brighthealth.io>, RapidSec Ops <ops@rapidsec.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Brian Miller <brian.miller@brighthealth.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of remediation and next steps for pen test

Claire / RapidSec —

Confirming next steps and closing the loop:

- BrightHealth has opted for the RapidSec targeted delta on Jan 18, 09:00–11:00 PST.
- Vivek will create two temporary test accounts (read-only) and post creds to the secure drive link below by EOD Jan 13.
- RapidSec will limit tests to the three remediated interfaces listed in the remediation binder (see remediation-evidence-binder.zip).
- RapidSec will produce a short delta report within 3 business days after testing.

For procurement: attached is a Redwood verification letter acknowledging that the listed fixes were deployed and that Redwood coordinated the retest (verification-letter-20270111.pdf). The letter does not replace RapidSec's delta report, but should help your audit team while the independent report is produced.

Attachments: verification-letter-20270111.pdf
Drive (evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3c4REDWOOD-EVIDENCE
Related ticket: JIRA-SEC-4321

If there are any phrasing edits required in the verification letter for procurement acceptance, let me know and I can issue an updated copy. Otherwise we'll proceed on the Jan 18 window and expect the delta by Jan 21.

Best,
Ethan Park
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
